CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingStreet)),Account.BillingStreet + BR(), NULL) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCity)), Account.BillingCity, NULL) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingState)), ", " + Account.BillingState, NULL) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingPostalCode)), ", " + Account.BillingPostalCode + BR(), NULL) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Account.BillingCountry)), Account.BillingCountry,NULL)
CustomField.label: Customer Billing Address
